correctness.rationale: Using the principal inverse-sine strip, \(|\sin(u+iv)|^2=\sin^2u+\sinh^2v\) gives the claimed image inequality in both directions. Differentiating the area integral gives \(I'(a)=\arctan(a)/a\), so the area is \(16G/\pi^2\). The sector estimate is sharp because the upper boundary has slope ratio tending to one at the cusp, and the canonical Ma--Minda extremal transfers that sharpness to strong starlikeness of order \(1/2\). A numerical quadrature independently reproduced Catalan's constant in the area integral.
residual_risks: The two recent arcsine preprints were available only through primary abstracts/metadata in this run; no full text could be obtained through the attempted lawful routes. The exact conformal calculation itself is self-contained.
